title: Runtime SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter for resolved creature geometry
description:
## Summary
Create a real runtime Unity `SkinnedMeshRenderer` adapter that installs already-authored binding data + the `CreatureRig` indexed bone hierarchy into Unity, producing the MVP's "generated creature rendered through a SkinnedMeshRenderer." This is the connective tissue that does not exist anywhere today.

## Scope
- A separate presentation adapter (NOT inside `CreatureRig`, NOT in the pure generation path). It consumes binding data (per-item weights from 0130/0131) + `CreatureRig`'s index-parallel `Transform[]` and builds once: `Mesh.boneWeights`/`BoneWeight` (cap 4, reuse `MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex`), `Mesh.bindposes` (full `Matrix4x4` inverse-rest-bone-in-mesh-local; bind==rest convention), and a `SkinnedMeshRenderer` with `.bones`/`.rootBone` from `CreatureRig`. Preserve submeshes/materials (MaterialRegion/ADR-009).
- Lock the shared `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` bone-index ordering invariant with 0130/0131; mesh-local==creature-space==rig-host-space at identity; mirrored bone handling via `SemanticBoneResolver`/`MirrorUtility`.
- `GeneratedCreature` stays pose-free; adapter is a pure data->Unity-Mesh converter (no re-derivation of weights/bindposes). Animation ticks only change bone Transform position/rotation; no mesh.SetVertices/RecalculateNormals/Bounds, no weight/bindpose/rebind rebuild per frame.
- Keep `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` as the cross-check oracle, not a per-frame runtime path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- SMR rest result == generated rest geometry within tolerance; one posed bone deforms expected vertices; posed->rest restores within tolerance.
- Posed SMR == `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` oracle within tolerance on the same real geometry (the test that proves Unity wiring, not just the math).
- Mirror: mirrored deformation == reflection of unmirrored via `MirrorUtility`.
- Renderer setup happens once; per-frame changes transforms only; no per-frame managed allocations or mesh rebuild (minimal zero-alloc ceiling embedded as acceptance).
- Ownership/lifecycle: rebuild/destroy/rebind leaves no orphaned generated objects; source mesh not modified.

## Validation
PLAY MODE REQUIRED (hard gate): `SkinnedMeshRenderer`/`Mesh.boneWeights`/`bindposes`/`bones`/`rootBone` are Engine types readable only in a running instance. Rest, posed, restore, mirror, and lifecycle tests in PlayMode on a real `GeneratedCreature`; plus dotnet builds and git diff --check. Cannot be marked Done without Unity validation.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): no live SkinnedMeshRenderer/boneWeights/bindposes/BoneWeight anywhere; CreatureRuntimePreview attaches static MeshFilter/MeshRenderer/MeshCollider per item, unrelated to CreatureRig. TSK-0077 satisfied only the LBS "documented equivalent" branch. Rig bones already exist as real GameObjects with cached index-parallel Transform[].

## Blockers
Unity execution required to close (PlayMode read-back). Consumes binding data from 0130/0131 and the indexed rig from TSK-0073/TSK-0118.

## Next Step
After 0133 driver-decision and TSK-0118 close; wire rigid items (0130 data) first, then implicit surface (0131 data). Parent TSK-0077 stays open until this lands (its tightened SMR-specific acceptance).

comments.body: Sprint round started. Consuming TSK-0131 in-worktree ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring (bind-index = SkeletonSnapshot.Capture order). Design: pure SkinnedMeshBindingBuilder (bindposes = TRS(rest.Pos,rest.Rot,one).inverse, bind==rest; BoneWeight cap 4) + thin runtime MonoBehaviour CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer that clones the source implicit-surface mesh (never mutates it), sets boneWeights/bindposes, and attaches a SkinnedMeshRenderer with .bones = CreatureRig indexed bones + rootBone = first root bone. Mesh-local == creature-space == rig-host-space at identity. Per-frame = rig.ApplyPose only (zero alloc, no mesh rebuild). LBS.Deform remains the oracle only. Needs a minimal read-only IndexedBones accessor on CreatureRig. Unity reachable; proceeding to implementation.

comments.body:
Sprint round implementation + validation evidence (TSK-0132).

CHANGED FILES (working tree, not committed):
- NEW Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/Skinned/SkinnedMeshBindingBuilder.cs — pure conversion: ComputeBindposes(SkeletonSnapshot) = TRS(rest.Pos,rest.Rot,one).inverse per bone (bind==rest, mesh-local==creature-space at identity); BuildBoneWeights caps at LinearBlendSkinning.MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex (4), validates in-range bone/weight/count. Headless-testable.
- NEW Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/Skinned/CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.cs — thin runtime MonoBehaviour presenter (NOT in CreatureRig, NOT in generation). Bind(rig, restSkeleton, sourceMesh, radiiByBoneIndex, materials): re-captures SkeletonSnapshot, authors welded weights ONCE via ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring (radius bridge owned here), clones the source mesh preserving submeshes (ADR-009), sets bindposes+boneWeights, attaches a SkinnedMeshRenderer with .bones = rig.IndexedBones (index-parallel) + rootBone = first root bone. Source mesh never modified; Clear()/OnDestroy destroys owned GO+mesh (no orphans). No per-frame work.
- EDITED Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/CreatureRig.cs — added read-only public IndexedBones (IReadOnlyList<Transform>) accessor (minimal; adapter stays outside the rig).
- NEW Tests: SkinnedMeshBindingBuilderTests (6 pure), CreatureSkinnedMeshRendererTests (7 PlayMode acceptance).

NON-OBVIOUS DECISIONS (for orchestrator review):
1) bindposes = Matrix4x4.TRS(rest.Position,rest.Rotation,one).inverse (bind==rest rigid inverse), NOT a local/hierarchy matrix — valid only because mesh-local==creature-space==rig-host-space at identity, so bone localToWorld == creature frame. Host must stay identity (same invariant as CreatureRig).
2) Bone Transform->SkeletonSnapshot index map: adapter re-captures the SAME Skeleton the rig was built from (Capture is deterministic), so its index i == rig.IndexedBones[i]. Enforced bone-count equality in Bind; weights' VertexInfluence.BoneIndex uses that Capture order (TSK-0131 contract).
3) rootBone = rig.IndexedBones[0] (first root bone in Capture order).
4) Submesh/material: skinning mesh is a deep copy preserving per-submesh triangles; materials optional param (implicit welded item has no MaterialRegions — single submesh, vertex-color); renderer left disabled (pure data converter; driver enables).
5) Mirror: adapter has NO mirror logic — mirrored bones flow through the rig (both chains) and are bound index-parallel like any bone; no identity rediscovery.

COMMANDS + RESULTS:
- Unity import/compile (refresh force+compile): 0 console errors.
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore: succeeded (exit 0).
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore: succeeded (exit 0).
- git diff --check: exit 0.
- PlayMode (real GeneratedCreature, SkeletonInferrer + CreatureRig + adapter), SkinnedMeshRenderer BakeMesh read-back:
  - New fixture run 13/13 Passed (SkinnedMeshBindingBuilderTests 6 + CreatureSkinnedMeshRendererTests 7).
  - Full ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime PlayMode suite: 610/610 Passed, 0 failed (regression clean), duration ~5.7s.
  - Zero-alloc: 1000 ApplyPose calls -> allocatedBytes=0 (~0.95 ms).

ACCEPTANCE COVERAGE: rest SMR==generated rest (pass); posed SMR==LinearBlendSkinning.Deform oracle on same real geometry (pass, 1-bone and 2-bone); posed->rest restore (pass); renderer setup once, per-frame transforms only, 0 managed alloc, no mesh/boneWeights/bindposes rebuild (pass); lifecycle rebind/destroy no orphans + source mesh unmodified + failed bind leaves no renderer (pass); mirror exercised via real mirrored-limb creature through SMR (pass: mirrored bones deform == LBS oracle).

RESIDUAL RISK: strict pointwise "reflected SMR mesh == reflection of unmirrored SMR mesh" equality through the full SMR is not asserted directly here; mirror reflection-equality is enforced at the pure layer (LinearBlendSkinning mirror tests + TSK-0131 authoring mirror test) and the new real mirrored-limb SMR==LBS test proves Unity deforms the mirrored chain identically to LBS on real geometry (the adapter adds no mirror logic). Mesh-asset/rigid-item weighting (TSK-0130), external pose driver (TSK-0133), per-frame budget benchmark (TSK-0134) intentionally NOT built (out of scope). Left in worktree; no commit made.

comments.body: Sprint R4 orchestrator review: independently re-ran focused PlayMode ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.CreatureSkinnedMeshRendererTests -> 7/7 passed (Rest==generated rest; Posed==LBS oracle; TwoBonePose==LBS; MirroredLimb posed==LBS; PerFrame 1000 ApplyPose allocatedBytes=0, ~0.99ms, no mesh/weight/bindpose rebuild; Lifecycle rebind no leak; FailedBind leaves no renderer + source mesh unmodified). Read the adapter: clean separation (separate presenter MonoBehaviour, not in CreatureRig/generation), pure bind-time converter, owns generated GO+mesh lifecycle (Clear/OnDestroy), never mutates source, preserves submeshes, enforces bind-index contract (snapshot.Count == rig.IndexedBones.Count). Residual risk (flagged by subagent, accepted): strict pointwise "reflected full-SMR mesh == reflection of unmirrored" is not directly asserted; mirror correctness is locked at the pure LBS/TSK-0131 layer + real mirrored-limb SMR==LBS test. Out of scope deferred: TSK-0130 rigid weighting, TSK-0133 pose driver, TSK-0134 per-frame budget. Parent TSK-0077 stays open (its SMR acceptance now delivered here).
